quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All twelve supplied main pages and all four content-matched SI pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. Absolute recipe scale and multiple workup conditions remain unreported. Keep the 0.02% feed EPR series, 0.20 +/- 0.01% measured colloids, 1.1% TOPO/MCD specimen and optical/model contexts separate. Preserve SI statistical-notation and Figure S3/Table S4 D/F conflicts. Films A-C preparation does not supply missing D-F coat counts or annealing conditions. An external undoped ZnO cell is a reference, not measured Mn:ZnO coordinates.
missing_fields: g-absolute-scale (Absolute recipe scale): No absolute reagent masses, stock/reaction volumes, yield, addition rate, wash volumes/cycle counts, separation force/time, or quantified initial capping stage are supplied. Retain partial protocols; do not call these fully quantified recipes or complete laboratory SOPs.

g-tmah-formula (TMAH formula discrepancy): Materials prints N(CH4)4OH·5H2O, whereas sample preparation prints N(Me)4OH·5H2O. Normalize the named tetramethylammonium identity while retaining the printed discrepancy.
g-base (Base amount and clouding): The titration begins to cloud beyond ca. 1.65 equivalents, while the common preparation uses 1.7 equivalents. Preserve the separate experimental scopes.

g-topo (TOPO route): The alternative procedure cites reference 32 without restating its full conditions. That referenced full paper was not inspected for this extraction. Keep the alternative partial; do not inherit the dodecylamine treatment conditions.

g-mn-feed (Feed and measured dopant content): Only the 0.20±0.01% product is explicitly linked to a 0.50% feed. The EPR series uses a 0.02% feed/nominal label; optical and MCD samples do not supply their initial feed. Retain separate sample identities and mask unavailable feed/outcome fields.
g-s4-count (SI table count): The main article announces three SI tables; the matched supplied SI contains four. Inventory all four, including the six-film Table S4.

g-poisson (SI statistical notation): The printed variables and λ definition mix concentration with mean dopants per particle. The reported means are 7.9 and 79, not fractions 0.0013 and 0.013. Preserve the equations, original figure and author-reported means as a model with a notation gap; do not silently repair it.

g-structure (Atomic structure and SAED): Wurtzite is supported by XRD and HRTEM. No experimental CIF, atomic coordinates, refined site occupancies, numerical lattice constants, or SAED pattern appear in the inspected main/SI. Allow phase/morphology evidence; exclude an exact experimental atomic-structure/recipe label.

g-film-df (Films D–F preparation): The SI gives film masses and magnetization, but omits coat counts, individual parent batches, and independently stated annealing conditions. Retain partial outcomes; do not assign 20 or 40 coats by proximity.
g-film-mass (Film masses): Main-text A–C masses are 0.59/0.24/0.28 mg; SI values are 593/236/279 μg. Both are retained as source reporting, consistent with rounding rather than separate replicates.

g-si-curve-table (Figure S3 / Table S4 conflict): Figure S3b visually orders mass-normalized high-field curves D > E > F, whereas Table S4 lists D = 0.038, E = 0.059, F = 0.076 emu/g. D/F identities or values are inconsistent between representations. Preserve the figure and table separately. Do not swap labels or assign resolved D/F outcome training targets. Independent audit must assess this conflict.

g-raw-curves (Raw plot data): Numerical curves and histogram counts were not supplied as raw arrays and have not been digitized. Readable original plots plus explicit scalar results are retained; do not claim raw-data recovery.

g-interpretation (Mechanistic evidence): Measured pH, carrier polarity/density, nitrogen content, and a quantitative impurity-detection limit are absent. Keep mechanistic hypotheses separate from measurements. Tc >350 K remains a lower bound.

g-other-techniques (Other characterization): No Raman, SAED, sample-specific DFT calculation, refined atomic structure, or electrical carrier-transport measurement is reported in these 16 pages. The actual additional property techniques are MCD, EPR and magnetometry; do not invent missing techniques.

quality.review_scope: All six supplied main pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. No matched supporting information was located or verified; SI existence remains unverified and no absence is inferred. Preserve the unspecified basis of the approximately 500:1 water/Sn ratio, acid-set treatment pH versus unreported final TBAOH measurement pH, and radius/diameter/model distinctions. XRD is mentioned but the inspected article supplies no trace, SAED or atomic coordinates.
missing_fields: Main-only review; matched SI not located/verified and existence remains unverified. No SI supplied or inferred absent.
Refs7/25 contain fuller upstream synthesis; their full procedures have not been inspected in this extraction. No external downloads performed.
Absolute precursor and ethanol/water charges, water-ratio basis/order/rate, mixing, vessel, atmosphere, hydrolysis duration and oxidation conditions absent.
Dialysis membrane, water volume/exchange schedule, duration and chloride-removal endpoint absent.
Acid concentration/dose, TBAOH addition volume, post-redispersion pH, sonication power and final colloid concentration absent.
No numerical full spectral curves, tabulated peak/radius values, histogram particle list, or uncertainties for optical-derived radii. Original plots retained without invented digitization.

Cassiterite assignment is source-reported XRD prose; no XRD trace or SAED pattern supplied. No unit-cell constants, measured atom coordinates, CIF, surface ligands or full-particle atom model supplied.
No powder-isolation protocol, quantitative yield, PL quantum yield/lifetime, Raman data or sensor/device test supplied.
Mechanistic conclusions involve author assumptions, models and cited studies; sample atomistic dynamics and solution oxidation/speciation were not directly measured.
conflicts: Discussion identifies Figure4 HRTEM but parenthetical references say Figure3a/b; actual Figure3 is schematic. Figure4 captions and panels establish the imaging assignment.
Figure5 ordinate-independent horizontal variable is particle radius; Figure6b axis says Size but caption says radius from PL. Preserve radius and original labels, never silently use diameter.
The paper describes acid-set pH, then adds basic TBAOH after24h for spectra without reporting final pH. Treat plotted labels as treatment labels, not verified final measurement pH.
p3 proposes polycondensation rather than direct ion deposition, while conclusion p6 uses ion-deposition phrasing; these are retained author interpretations, not a resolved measured mechanism.

quality.review_scope: All six supplied main pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. No matched supporting information was located or verified; SI existence remains unverified and no absence is inferred. Preserve the unspecified basis of the approximately 500:1 water/Sn ratio, acid-set treatment pH versus unreported final TBAOH measurement pH, and radius/diameter/model distinctions. XRD is mentioned but the inspected article supplies no trace, SAED or atomic coordinates.
missing_fields: Main-only review; matched SI not located/verified and existence remains unverified. No SI supplied or inferred absent.
Refs7/25 contain fuller upstream synthesis; their full procedures have not been inspected in this extraction. No external downloads performed.
Absolute precursor and ethanol/water charges, water-ratio basis/order/rate, mixing, vessel, atmosphere, hydrolysis duration and oxidation conditions absent.
Dialysis membrane, water volume/exchange schedule, duration and chloride-removal endpoint absent.
Acid concentration/dose, TBAOH addition volume, post-redispersion pH, sonication power and final colloid concentration absent.
No numerical full spectral curves, tabulated peak/radius values, histogram particle list, or uncertainties for optical-derived radii. Original plots retained without invented digitization.

Cassiterite assignment is source-reported XRD prose; no XRD trace or SAED pattern supplied. No unit-cell constants, measured atom coordinates, CIF, surface ligands or full-particle atom model supplied.
No powder-isolation protocol, quantitative yield, PL quantum yield/lifetime, Raman data or sensor/device test supplied.
Mechanistic conclusions involve author assumptions, models and cited studies; sample atomistic dynamics and solution oxidation/speciation were not directly measured.
conflicts: Discussion identifies Figure4 HRTEM but parenthetical references say Figure3a/b; actual Figure3 is schematic. Figure4 captions and panels establish the imaging assignment.
Figure5 ordinate-independent horizontal variable is particle radius; Figure6b axis says Size but caption says radius from PL. Preserve radius and original labels, never silently use diameter.
The paper describes acid-set pH, then adds basic TBAOH after24h for spectra without reporting final pH. Treat plotted labels as treatment labels, not verified final measurement pH.
p3 proposes polycondensation rather than direct ion deposition, while conclusion p6 uses ion-deposition phrasing; these are retained author interpretations, not a resolved measured mechanism.

quality.review_scope: All six supplied main pages completely read and visually inspected; independent source, canonical, reader and private visual audits passed. No matched supporting information was located or verified; SI existence remains unverified and no absence is inferred. Preserve the unspecified basis of the approximately 500:1 water/Sn ratio, acid-set treatment pH versus unreported final TBAOH measurement pH, and radius/diameter/model distinctions. XRD is mentioned but the inspected article supplies no trace, SAED or atomic coordinates.
missing_fields: Main-only review; matched SI not located/verified and existence remains unverified. No SI supplied or inferred absent.
Refs7/25 contain fuller upstream synthesis; their full procedures have not been inspected in this extraction. No external downloads performed.
Absolute precursor and ethanol/water charges, water-ratio basis/order/rate, mixing, vessel, atmosphere, hydrolysis duration and oxidation conditions absent.
Dialysis membrane, water volume/exchange schedule, duration and chloride-removal endpoint absent.
Acid concentration/dose, TBAOH addition volume, post-redispersion pH, sonication power and final colloid concentration absent.
No numerical full spectral curves, tabulated peak/radius values, histogram particle list, or uncertainties for optical-derived radii. Original plots retained without invented digitization.

Cassiterite assignment is source-reported XRD prose; no XRD trace or SAED pattern supplied. No unit-cell constants, measured atom coordinates, CIF, surface ligands or full-particle atom model supplied.
No powder-isolation protocol, quantitative yield, PL quantum yield/lifetime, Raman data or sensor/device test supplied.
Mechanistic conclusions involve author assumptions, models and cited studies; sample atomistic dynamics and solution oxidation/speciation were not directly measured.
conflicts: Discussion identifies Figure4 HRTEM but parenthetical references say Figure3a/b; actual Figure3 is schematic. Figure4 captions and panels establish the imaging assignment.
Figure5 ordinate-independent horizontal variable is particle radius; Figure6b axis says Size but caption says radius from PL. Preserve radius and original labels, never silently use diameter.
The paper describes acid-set pH, then adds basic TBAOH after24h for spectra without reporting final pH. Treat plotted labels as treatment labels, not verified final measurement pH.
p3 proposes polycondensation rather than direct ion deposition, while conclusion p6 uses ion-deposition phrasing; these are retained author interpretations, not a resolved measured mechanism.

conflicts: Figure 2 caption and opening paragraph give 10/10.0 mM Ag+, but detailed n++ discussion and general plating recipe give 1.0 mM. Figure 3 separately gives 1.5 mM.
Figure 2d caption repeats n++-Si while body and comparison identify n-Si. Preserve body/caption distinction.
Figure 5 caption and body print mC/cm² for 1.6/3.6/8.3/18.7 and 222 per monolayer; Figures 7/9 explicitly print µC/cm². Do not silently normalize source charge units.
Equivalent monolayers are upper-bound charge-derived amounts assuming 100% efficiency, not measured planar-area fraction or exact shell thickness.
Four histograms and four listed pulse durations appear, although Figure 7 caption says five samples. Five random image fields per sample is a different count.
First histogram mean/sigma are 2.2/2.4 nm; body gives smallest height 2.4 and spread 2 nm. Largest histogram sigma 6.1 nm versus rounded body 6 nm.
Figure 8 actual ordinate is particle density, not captioned mean height. The height-distribution ±sigma wording cannot establish the density error-bar statistic.
Body nucleation-rate range uses cm−2 ms−1; summary uses cm−2 s−1 with rounded values. Both are retained as conflicting source statements.
Abstract, body and summary give different rounded initial/saturation ranges. Current-model N∞ is approximately an order of magnitude above microscopy density.
Body says no Ag before 2–3 ms while Figure 5 includes a 2 ms image; low-end object density is close to contamination background. No detection-corrected nucleus count is provided.
NC-AFM height is measured; tip-convolved width is not true diameter. Approximately spherical diameter-as-height rationale differs from the hemispherical height-as-radius model.
TEM 10–25 Å objects have unspecified pulse duration and were mechanically transferred. They are not a verified same-sample match to 2–20 nm AFM height populations.
Table 1 expected spacings and intensities are ICDD reference values, not measured specimen intensities. Printed 111 reference spacing is 2.32 Å and must not be silently repaired.
Aqueous instability paragraph names AgO; later phase test contrasts Ag0 with Ag2O. The metallic SAED assignment is retained without creating an oxide synthesis record.
Printed Equation 2 contains A and lacks the explicit F factor present in Equation 1. A is not defined numerically; exact reproduction of N∞ is not supported by note 43 alone.
Band edges were not measured. Barrier energies, depletion widths and geometric N fits are models; z = 1 and hemispherical morphology are assumptions.
Equation 3 discussion refers to Figure 8 predictions, but the model curves are in Figure 9.
Summary says nucleation ceases near 20 ms; body explicitly limits measurements to ≤30 ms and allows undetectably slow continued nucleation on longer times.
TEM method calls 200 keV an accelerating voltage. Preserve the beam setting with its printed energy unit rather than silently transcribing kV.
Figure 2 labels potential in V but numerical ticks and body potentials are in the hundreds of mV. Preserve original axis and use explicit body mV data for typed features.
Step-height ±0.4 Å lacks statistic; Figure 7 sigma denotes height spread; Figure 8 error-bar definition conflicts with its ordinate; Figure 9 ±sigma is height spread, not SEM.
Figure 5, Figure 7, TEM transfer, current transients and the 15-experiment three-day series are source contexts with unknown exact physical sample joins.
Plotted current density includes multiple Faradaic processes; no current efficiency or exact silver mass is established by total charge alone.

Figure 7 contains four displayed histograms and lists four pulse durations, but its caption says five samples. The top panel mean 2.2 nm and sigma 2.4 nm differ from body values 2.4 nm and 2 nm. Four source panels are retained, not a reconstructed fifth specimen.

Figure 8 ordinate is particle density (µm−2) and its discussion concerns nucleation density, while its caption says mean height and height-distribution error bars. The axis/body interpretation is retained with ambiguous error-bar semantics.
Nucleation rates on printed p.797 use cm−2 ms−1, whereas the Summary uses cm−2 s−1. These are separately scoped statements, not a normalized rate label.
Table 1 prints expected FCC Ag (111) d spacing 2.32 Å versus experimental 2.37 Å. No corrected reference value is substituted.

Equation 2 includes an undefined A and does not show the F that appears in Equation 1. Preserve the original equation rather than silently repair it. The text on p.798 refers to Figure 8 for the size–charge model plotted in Figure 9.

conflicts: Main text gives 3 psig and 1.22 × 10^5 Pa together, without labeling the latter absolute. They are not the same pressure basis.
First-use TOAB TOF is 4 s^-1 in body text, 5 s^-1 in Figure 2/Figure 4 captions.

Note 33 refers to anions in a positively charged polymer; main model describes a cation-exchange resin. Keep this as source-context ambiguity, not corrected physical proof.

The abstract describes a formation rate proportional to sqrt(time), but Figure 8 and body fit absorbance itself against sqrt(time). Represent the observed ordinate as absorbance; do not turn its slope into dA/dt.
Figure 2 uses filled circles for salt and open circles for no salt; Figures 8–9 use the reverse. Bind marker identity separately for each figure.
Figure 1 panels a/b mean 30 min/48 h, whereas the preparation sample labels a/b mean no salt/salt. Keep both independent dimensions of identity.

100–110 um is host diameter; micrometer depths/L describe CdS location in that host; nanometer sizes describe CdS constituent crystals. Use separate typed properties, not one size field.
The optical plateau within 2 h for b is not the end of the preparative 2 h stir plus 2 day standing sequence. Store protocol durations separately from the observed optical-progress interpretation.

The HS− coefficients use an optical L proxy and diffusion scaling; Na+ diffusion is a cited resin-context value associated with Chelex 100, and Donnan potential values are model calculations. Keep separate species, methods, and evidence classes.

quality.review_scope: All five supplied main pages text-read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Five hydrothermal annealing comparisons, independent solid-state bulk preparation, stock preparation, structural/optical analyses and author mechanisms retain their own evidence scopes. Printed mass/mole and nominal feed/formula conflicts, individual comparison charges and unassigned analysis specimens remain explicit. Matching SI not located or verified; cited external works not independently inspected.
missing_fields: No verified SI, raw spectral arrays, atomic coordinates, refined dopant occupancies or absolute quantum yield is supplied.
Physical batch identifiers and most characterization specimen preparation/settings are absent; general figure context is not a per-run sample join.

Diluted nitric acid concentration/volume, stock pH, hydrothermal pressure/ramp/cooling, wash volume, air-drying duration/temperature, annealing atmosphere, isolated yield and sample mass are unreported.
conflicts: Printed ammonium molybdate identity (NH4)2MoO4, 1.961 g and 9.37 mmol are inconsistent. The reported Mo and rare-earth amounts also do not directly match nominal La2(MoO4)3 stoichiometry; no correction or actual product occupancy is inferred.

quality.review_scope: All five supplied main pages text-read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Five hydrothermal annealing comparisons, independent solid-state bulk preparation, stock preparation, structural/optical analyses and author mechanisms retain their own evidence scopes. Printed mass/mole and nominal feed/formula conflicts, individual comparison charges and unassigned analysis specimens remain explicit. Matching SI not located or verified; cited external works not independently inspected.
missing_fields: No verified SI, raw spectral arrays, atomic coordinates, refined dopant occupancies or absolute quantum yield is supplied.
Physical batch identifiers and most characterization specimen preparation/settings are absent; general figure context is not a per-run sample join.

Diluted nitric acid concentration/volume, stock pH, hydrothermal pressure/ramp/cooling, wash volume, air-drying duration/temperature, annealing atmosphere, isolated yield and sample mass are unreported.
conflicts: Printed ammonium molybdate identity (NH4)2MoO4, 1.961 g and 9.37 mmol are inconsistent. The reported Mo and rare-earth amounts also do not directly match nominal La2(MoO4)3 stoichiometry; no correction or actual product occupancy is inferred.

quality.review_scope: Main protocol, Table 1 TDPA row, TEM label and corresponding SI optical/XRD panels visually checked. Common method applies to selected formulation; no independently identified batch or repeat count.
missing_fields: resolved Cs2CO3 mass/amount basis
pressure during either degassing hold
stirring rate and heating ramps
numerical injection/quench delay
N2 flow rate
first wash absolute solvent volume
final toluene volume and concentration
storage temperature/duration
run identifier and replicate count
sample-specific atomic coordinates/CIF
Table 1 particle-size metric and statistical meaning of +/-1.4 nm
conflicts: 16 mg Cs2CO3 corresponds to about 0.049 mmol formula units (about 0.098 mmol Cs atoms), whereas 0.1 mmol formula units would be about 32.6 mg. Source does not specify a Cs-atom basis for the parenthesis. Preserve both printed values and leave the basis unresolved; do not silently choose a correction.
Figure 1e axis and methods say solvodynamic diameter, whereas caption says radius. Do not use that DLS axis as an unambiguous alternative particle-size label without separate review.
Paper identifies orthorhombic phase but uses cubic facet nomenclature for convenience. This is not evidence of cubic crystal phase.
